title: Thick sphere under internal pressure (3D octant)
description:
Thick-walled steel sphere (spherical pressure vessel) under internal pressure, 3D. By symmetry only the octant x >= 0, y >= 0, z >= 0 is modelled (STEP: a solid octant of a spherical shell).
Geometry: spherical shell centred on the origin, inner radius a = 0.1 m, outer radius b = 0.2 m, cut by the three coordinate planes. Faces: inner sphere r = a, outer sphere r = b, and the three planar faces on x = 0, y = 0 and z = 0.
Material: linear elastic, E = 2e+11 Pa, nu = 0.3.
Loads: uniform internal pressure p = 1e+08 Pa (100 MPa) on the inner spherical face. The outer face is traction free.
Supports: symmetry on x = 0 (u_x = 0), y = 0 (u_y = 0) and z = 0 (u_z = 0).
Report (SI units):
  ur_bore       radial displacement at the bore, u_x at (a, 0, 0) [m]
  hoop_bore     hoop stress at the bore in the plane y = 0 at 45 degrees, sigma_yy at (a/sqrt(2), 0, a/sqrt(2)) = (0.0707107, 0, 0.0707107) m [Pa]
  vm_max        maximum von Mises stress [Pa]
  strain_energy total strain energy of the modelled octant [J]
